name: @swao/module-html-report
description: SWAO HTML publication module (Community tier): the Mode A single-page HTML renderer (the shipping feature), the `publish` CLI command, the Publish / Serve TUI screens and the Publication Editor (publish --edit, a node:http server). ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 4, #0575. The Consultant HTML Portal (Mode B site builder, portfolio portal, live portal server) relocated to @swao/module-html-portal (#0582 module-split stage 2). The host injects the SWAO version (branding is host-only) and the portal builder via registerPublish.
